title: Beyond HODLing: How Bitcoin-Backed Loans Can Unlock New Financial Opportunities
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Beyond HODLing: How Bitcoin-Backed Loans Can Unlock New Financial Opportunities SALT Lending highlights how Bitcoin holders can access liquidity for real estate, business expansion, and other financial opportunities without selling their Bitcoin. This post Beyond HODLing: How Bitcoin-Backed Loans Can Unlock New Financial Opportunities first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Josh Plischke .
